annotations.text:
Tabs row
The tab bar holds only places: Home, Orders, and the trailing search tab for the catalog. Scanning is Home's one prominent button. The active order sits above the tab bar on every tab.

Orders adds status segments; today that tab lists only open orders.

Scan to checkout
The scanner is full-screen; product, cart and delivery are sheets. On the product sheet you pick a warehouse row (checkmark) and set quantity with one stepper, replacing today's per-row + buttons.

Save for later and delete order move into the cart's ⋯ menu.

Empty cart
No order yet: no client and no products. The sheet says the cart is empty and offers the two ways to add a product: scanning is the one prominent button, manual search sits under it. There is no ⋯ menu, since there is no order to save or delete.

შემდეგი stays disabled until the first product is added, as it is today. The total reads 0.00 ₾ rather than hiding, so the bar keeps its place.

Home stays as it always is, with scanning already its prominent button. The active-order bar stays in place but idle: a soft cart icon, no badge (iOS hides zero badges), კალათა · ცარიელია. It is quiet but not grayed out: gray would read as disabled, and tapping it still opens the empty cart.

Client
Lookup uses 3 tabs: ID, phone and name. The selected tab labels the field and picks the keyboard, the number pad for ID and phone and letters for a name (3+ characters). The create form puts every label above its field and stacks the phone fields.

The alternatives we considered (A, C, D) are in the row below.

Lookup alternatives
B (3 tabs, above) is the default. A, B and C show the same name search so they compare directly; D shows the number pad, which is its whole point.

A · One field: fewest controls. Digits search ID and phone, letters search names. Opens the letters keyboard, so digits take a tap on 123.

B · 3 tabs (chosen): explicit, and the ID and phone tabs open the number pad. 1C searches ID and phone the same way, so those two tabs return the same client either way.

C · 2 tabs: matches the two searches 1C has and still picks the keyboard. A name search starts with a tap.

D · Number pad first: one field, fastest for IDs and phones. The აბგ key switches to letters for a name.
